newsitem.title: USA: Burlington acquires Italian forwarder LDS.
newsitem.headline: Burlington acquires Italian forwarder LDS.

text.p: Burlington Air Express Inc said it has acquired Italian freight forwarder LDS, SpA.
LDS' operations will be renamed and merged into Burlington's international network, the latter said in a statement.
LDS, the former distribution division of Pirelli, has offices in Milan, Florence and Hong Kong, which acquires its air and ocean freight business, the statement added.
Burlington said LDS has achieved substantial growth in its traffic between southern Europe and Pacific Rim markets, notably Hong Kong, Seoul, Singapore and Taipei.
